Latitudinal regions

Source: R/domain.R
classify_regions.Rd

Classifies latitudes into bands. With breaks = c(-20, 20) and labels = c("R01", "R02", "R03") this is the rule of Experimento 02: R01 when lat > 20, R03 when lat < -20 and R02 otherwise (both limits inclusive). In general, the southernmost and northernmost bands are open and every interior band is closed at its southern limit (the northernmost interior band is closed at both limits).

Usage

classify_regions(lat, breaks = c(-20, 20), labels = c("R01", "R02", "R03"))

Arguments

lat

Numeric vector of latitudes.

breaks

Ascending latitude limits (may be empty: one region).

labels

Region labels ordered from north to south; length(breaks) + 1 elements.

Value

Factor with levels labels.

Examples

classify_regions(c(-35, -20, 0, 20, 35))
#> [1] R03 R02 R02 R02 R01
#> Levels: R01 R02 R03
classify_regions(c(-35, 0, 35), breaks = 0, labels = c("North", "South"))
#> [1] South South North
#> Levels: North South
